findings.finding: Bounded partial inner products alone do not establish convergence. The conclusion is true but the compressed argument should apply the finite dot-product inequality to tail blocks. Core assessed domain calculations do not depend on this assertion.
findings.suggested_repair: State that sums of absolute tail products are bounded by the product of square-tail norms, which tends to zero; hence the series is absolutely convergent.
